exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) with satisfactory blood glucose control
outcome: Fetal lung development parameters (Acceleration time (AT), AT/ejection time (AT/ET), diameter of fetal lung development)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) with satisfactory blood glucose control and 200 normal pregnant women undergoing prenatal examination.
finding: There was no significant difference in fetal lung development or neonatal birth outcomes between pregnant women with satisfactory GDM blood glucose control and normal pregnant women.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in fetal delivery mode between pregnant women with GDM and normal pregnant women.
followup_time: Up to delivery and early neonatal period
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken from 31 to 38 (+ 6) weeks of gestation, with groups divided into 8 time periods based on gestational age.
